units.id: conversation:boarding pirate|You make short-range scans of the <origin>'s outfits and cargo. Among the cargo, you find a crate full of credit chips worth <payment>. You drag the crate onto your ship before considering your next move.|417|0
units.english: You make short-range scans of the <origin>'s outfits and cargo. Among the cargo, you find a crate full of credit chips worth <payment>. You drag the crate onto your ship before considering your next move.
units.italian: Fai una scansione a corto raggio delle dotazioni e del carico della <origin>. Tra il carico trovi una cassa piena di gettoni di credito per un valore di <payment>. Trascini la cassa sulla tua nave prima di pensare alla prossima mossa.

units.id: mission:Pirate Ambush|You board the <origin>, but find no crew aboard. When you reach the cockpit of the ship, you look out into space to see an escape pod floating away. The <origin> is emitting a distress signal to nearby pirates, and a self-destruct sequence has been activated! You run back to your ship and get ready to fight.|479|0
units.english: You board the <origin>, but find no crew aboard. When you reach the cockpit of the ship, you look out into space to see an escape pod floating away. The <origin> is emitting a distress signal to nearby pirates, and a self-destruct sequence has been activated! You run back to your ship and get ready to fight.
units.italian: Sali a bordo della <origin>, ma non trovi nessun membro dell'equipaggio. Quando raggiungi la cabina di pilotaggio, guardi nello spazio e vedi una capsula di salvataggio che si allontana fluttuando. La <origin> sta emettendo un segnale di soccorso verso i pirati vicini, e una sequenza di autodistruzione è stata attivata! Corri di nuovo sulla tua nave e ti prepari a combattere.

units.id: mission:Pirate Mutiny|description|492|0
units.english: Bring <bunks> ex-pirate crew members to <destination>.
units.italian: Porta <bunks> membri dell'equipaggio, ex pirati, su <destination>.

units.id: mission:Pirate Mutiny|When you board the <origin>, you find most of the crew already dead. One of the surviving crew members, who looks like a teenaged boy no older than 16, approaches you with his hands in the air. He explains that after the ship was disabled, a section of the crew decided to overthrow the tyrannical captain. He continues, saying how most pirate crew members are forced into servitude on pirate ships. The surviving <bunks> crew members beg you to bring them to <destination> so that they can escape from pirate slavery.|505|0
units.english: When you board the <origin>, you find most of the crew already dead. One of the surviving crew members, who looks like a teenaged boy no older than 16, approaches you with his hands in the air. He explains that after the ship was disabled, a section of the crew decided to overthrow the tyrannical captain. He continues, saying how most pirate crew members are forced into servitude on pirate ships. The surviving <bunks> crew members beg you to bring them to <destination> so that they can escape from pirate slavery.
units.italian: Quando sali a bordo della <origin>, trovi la maggior parte dell'equipaggio già morta. Uno dei superstiti, che sembra un ragazzo non più grande di sedici anni, ti si avvicina con le mani in aria. Spiega che dopo che la nave è stata messa fuori uso, una parte dell'equipaggio ha deciso di rovesciare il capitano tiranno. Continua dicendo che la maggior parte dei pirati viene costretta in servitù sulle navi pirata. I <bunks> superstiti ti supplicano di portarli su <destination> perché possano fuggire dalla schiavitù dei pirati.

units.id: mission:Pirate Mutiny|	The fight seems to have damaged the ship beyond repair. It may not last much longer in the vacuum of space if you leave the pirates here.|506|0
units.english: The fight seems to have damaged the ship beyond repair. It may not last much longer in the vacuum of space if you leave the pirates here.
units.italian: La battaglia sembra aver danneggiato la nave oltre ogni riparazione. Se lasci qui i pirati, potrebbe non durare molto più a lungo nel vuoto dello spazio.

units.id: mission:Pirate Mutiny|	(Help the pirate crew.)|508|0
units.english: (Help the pirate crew.)
units.italian: (Aiuta l'equipaggio pirata.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Mutiny|	(Leave the pirate crew.)|510|0
units.english: (Leave the pirate crew.)
units.italian: (Lascia l'equipaggio pirata.)

units.id: mission:Pirate Mutiny|dialog|514|0
units.english: The pirate crew members thank you for bringing them to <planet>. One of them hands you a small payment of <payment>. You wish them all the best of luck with their new lives and part ways.
units.italian: I membri dell'equipaggio pirata ti ringraziano per averli portati su <planet>. Uno di loro ti consegna un piccolo pagamento di <payment>. Auguri a tutti loro di fare fortuna nella nuova vita, e vi separate.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|You leave your ship empty and board the <origin> alone. Though you aren't expecting any danger, you still feel apprehensive all by yourself on an unknown disabled vessel, so you make sure to bring a sidearm. Your apprehension rises as you realize you can't hear any sounds of frantic activity or see crew members scurrying around trying to repair damage like you would expect. Making your way to the bridge, you relax upon seeing a single handsome and well-dressed young man welding a bulkhead. His movements are dexterous and competent, but your practiced eye tells you that the bulkhead is damaged beyond repair, so his work is futile. He looks up and introduces himself as captain Tarquin, offering the princely sum of 350,000 credits for your expert help repairing his vessel.|540|0
units.english: You leave your ship empty and board the <origin> alone. Though you aren't expecting any danger, you still feel apprehensive all by yourself on an unknown disabled vessel, so you make sure to bring a sidearm. Your apprehension rises as you realize you can't hear any sounds of frantic activity or see crew members scurrying around trying to repair damage like you would expect. Making your way to the bridge, you relax upon seeing a single handsome and well-dressed young man welding a bulkhead. His movements are dexterous and competent, but your practiced eye tells you that the bulkhead is damaged beyond repair, so his work is futile. He looks up and introduces himself as captain Tarquin, offering the princely sum of 350,000 credits for your expert help repairing his vessel.
units.italian: Lasci la tua nave vuota e sali da solo sulla <origin>. Anche se non ti aspetti alcun pericolo, ti senti comunque apprensivo, tutto solo su un vascello sconosciuto e in avaria, così ti assicuri di portare un'arma da fianco. L'apprensione cresce quando ti rendi conto di non sentire alcun suono di attività frenetica né di vedere membri dell'equipaggio correre qua e là a riparare i danni come ti aspetteresti. Mentre raggiungi il ponte di comando, ti rilassi vedendo un solo giovane elegante e ben vestito che salda una paratia. I suoi movimenti sono agili e competenti, ma il tuo occhio esperto ti dice che la paratia è danneggiata oltre ogni riparazione, quindi il suo lavoro è inutile. Alza lo sguardo e si presenta come capitano Tarquin, offrendoti la principesca somma di 350.000 crediti per il tuo aiuto esperto nel riparare il suo vascello.

units.italian: (Accetta questo generoso pagamento e aiuta a riparare la nave.)

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	"Not to look a gift horse in the mouth, but why are you offering so much money for my assistance?"|554|0
units.english: "Not to look a gift horse in the mouth, but why are you offering so much money for my assistance?"
units.italian: "Non vorrei guardare in bocca al cavallo donato, ma perché offri così tanti soldi per il mio aiuto?"

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	"Can we get some help from your crew?"|556|0
units.english: "Can we get some help from your crew?"
units.italian: "Possiamo avere un po' di aiuto dal tuo equipaggio?"

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	"Shouldn't a ship of this size have more crew?"|558|0
units.english: "Shouldn't a ship of this size have more crew?"
units.italian: "Una nave di queste dimensioni non dovrebbe avere più equipaggio?"

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	Tarquin laughs self-consciously. "The truth is, I'm a bit desperate," he says. "My cargo hold is full of perishable goods that need to be delivered in three days to a very important client who will probably cut me off if I don't make the deadline. I thought I could save money by hiring inexperienced peasants to crew the ship, but as you can see, that hasn't worked out very well. They're cowering in their quarters even now. I'm offering you my profits from being a cheapskate. We'll call it paying for a lesson learned.|562|0
units.english: Tarquin laughs self-consciously. "The truth is, I'm a bit desperate," he says. "My cargo hold is full of perishable goods that need to be delivered in three days to a very important client who will probably cut me off if I don't make the deadline. I thought I could save money by hiring inexperienced peasants to crew the ship, but as you can see, that hasn't worked out very well. They're cowering in their quarters even now. I'm offering you my profits from being a cheapskate. We'll call it paying for a lesson learned.
units.italian: Tarquin ride con un po' d'imbarazzo. "La verità è che sono un po' disperato", dice. "La mia stiva è piena di merci deperibili che devono essere consegnate entro tre giorni a un cliente molto importante, che probabilmente mi taglierà fuori se non rispetto la scadenza. Ho pensato di risparmiare assumendo contadini inesperti come equipaggio, ma come vedi non ha funzionato granché bene. Sono rintanati nei loro alloggi anche adesso. Ti sto offrendo i miei profitti da spilorcio. Chiamiamolo pagare per una lezione imparata.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|label|565|0
units.english: crew missing
units.italian: crew missing

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	Tarquin laughs heartily. "That lot? They're a bunch of simple peasants I picked up on New India, off hiding in their quarters right now. The bumpkins are unaccustomed to this kind of danger, and don't have a lot of technical skills. My fault for being too cheap to hire good help, I suppose. I'm definitely going to pick up some more experienced and reliable crewmen after we get out of this mess."|566|0
units.english: Tarquin laughs heartily. "That lot? They're a bunch of simple peasants I picked up on New India, off hiding in their quarters right now. The bumpkins are unaccustomed to this kind of danger, and don't have a lot of technical skills. My fault for being too cheap to hire good help, I suppose. I'm definitely going to pick up some more experienced and reliable crewmen after we get out of this mess."
units.italian: Tarquin ride di gusto. "Quella gente? Sono un branco di semplici contadini che ho raccolto su New India, nascosti nei loro alloggi in questo momento. Gli zotici non sono abituati a questo genere di pericolo e non hanno grandi capacità tecniche. Colpa mia, che sono stato troppo tirchio per assumere gente valida, suppongo. Dopo che saremo usciti da questo pasticcio, prenderò di sicuro qualche membro dell'equipaggio più esperto e affidabile."

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|label|568|0
units.english: get to work
units.italian: get to work

units.italian: "Possiamo metterci al lavoro adesso?"

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	(Get to work repairing the ship.)|571|0
units.english: (Get to work repairing the ship.)

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	(Press the matter.)|573|0

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	Something about captain Tarquin's explanation doesn't sit right with you, so you keep asking questions to distract him while subtly walking towards the ship's crew section. As you get closer, you start to hear the faint sounds of people banging on walls and yelling for help. Tarquin's face displays an almost uncannily neutral expression, but his body is taut, as though every muscle has tensed up all at once.|574|0
units.english: Something about captain Tarquin's explanation doesn't sit right with you, so you keep asking questions to distract him while subtly walking towards the ship's crew section. As you get closer, you start to hear the faint sounds of people banging on walls and yelling for help. Tarquin's face displays an almost uncannily neutral expression, but his body is taut, as though every muscle has tensed up all at once.
units.italian: Qualcosa nella spiegazione del capitano Tarquin non ti convince, così continui a fargli domande per distrarlo mentre ti avvicini con discrezione alla sezione alloggi dell'equipaggio. Man mano che ti avvicini cominci a sentire i deboli suoni di persone che battono sui muri e gridano aiuto. Il volto di Tarquin mostra un'espressione quasi inquietantemente neutra, ma il suo corpo è teso, come se ogni muscolo si fosse contratto in una volta sola.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	"I think we took a wrong turn. Let's go repair your ship."|576|0
units.english: "I think we took a wrong turn. Let's go repair your ship."
units.italian: "Credo che abbiamo sbagliato strada. Andiamo a riparare la tua nave."

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	"Now I see what kind of ship you're running, but don't worry, you're among friends. No charge for those repairs."|578|0
units.english: "Now I see what kind of ship you're running, but don't worry, you're among friends. No charge for those repairs."
units.italian: "Ora vedo che tipo di nave gestisci, ma non preoccuparti, sei tra amici. Le riparazioni sono gratis."

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	"I'll help you, but the price just rose to a million credits, or I leave you here and tell the authorities that you're running a slave ship."|580|0
units.english: "I'll help you, but the price just rose to a million credits, or I leave you here and tell the authorities that you're running a slave ship."
units.italian: "Ti aiuterò, ma il prezzo è appena salito a un milione di crediti, oppure ti lascio qui e dico alle autorità che gestisci una nave negriera."

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	"I demand that you release your slaves."|582|0
units.english: "I demand that you release your slaves."
units.italian: "Pretendo che tu liberi i tuoi schiavi."

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	(Attack him immediately.)|584|0
units.english: (Attack him immediately.)
units.italian: (Attaccalo subito.)

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	"Yes, let's do that," replies Tarquin. However, his friendly attitude is gone, and he remains as tense as a steel cable. You work in stony silence and awkwardly collect your payment once the <origin> is up and running again.|588|0
units.english: "Yes, let's do that," replies Tarquin. However, his friendly attitude is gone, and he remains as tense as a steel cable. You work in stony silence and awkwardly collect your payment once the <origin> is up and running again.
units.italian: "Sì, facciamolo", risponde Tarquin. Però la sua aria amichevole è sparita, e resta teso come un cavo d'acciaio. Lavorate in un silenzio di pietra e ritiri goffamente il tuo pagamento quando la <origin> torna a funzionare.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	You feel relieved that the whole situation is over once you're safely back on board your own ship.|591|0
units.english: You feel relieved that the whole situation is over once you're safely back on board your own ship.
units.italian: Ti senti sollevato che tutta la faccenda sia finita quando sei al sicuro di nuovo a bordo della tua nave.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|label|594|0
units.english: trickster or monster
units.italian: trickster or monster

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	Tarquin relaxes. "It's so nice to encounter a like-minded captain in this unfriendly galaxy," he says. "I wouldn't dream of accepting repairs for free. Take the money anyway, I insist."|595|0
units.english: Tarquin relaxes. "It's so nice to encounter a like-minded captain in this unfriendly galaxy," he says. "I wouldn't dream of accepting repairs for free. Take the money anyway, I insist."
units.italian: Tarquin si rilassa. "È così bello incontrare un capitano che la pensa come me in questa galassia ostile", dice. "Non mi sognerei mai di accettare riparazioni gratis. Prendi comunque i soldi, insisto."

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	(Now go repair his ship.)|597|0
units.english: (Now go repair his ship.)
units.italian: (Ora vai a riparare la sua nave.)

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	Tarquin can't hope to stand alone against your entire boarding party and quickly surrenders. A look of cold fury glints in his eyes, even as the rest of his face remains calm.|620|0
units.english: Tarquin can't hope to stand alone against your entire boarding party and quickly surrenders. A look of cold fury glints in his eyes, even as the rest of his face remains calm.
units.italian: Tarquin non può sperare di reggere da solo contro tutto il tuo gruppo d'abbordaggio e si arrende in fretta. Uno sguardo di furia fredda gli brilla negli occhi, mentre il resto del volto resta calmo.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	(Execute him here and now.)|622|0
units.english: (Execute him here and now.)
units.italian: (Giustizialo qui e ora.)

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	(Take him prisoner.)|624|0
units.english: (Take him prisoner.)
units.italian: (Prendilo prigioniero.)

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	You instruct one of the members of your boarding party to tie him up and guard him. Tarquin curses you foully and bucks around as you search him, finding a concealed handgun and knife, and the credit chip he was going to pay you. You go to rescue the ship's crew.|628|0
units.english: You instruct one of the members of your boarding party to tie him up and guard him. Tarquin curses you foully and bucks around as you search him, finding a concealed handgun and knife, and the credit chip he was going to pay you. You go to rescue the ship's crew.
units.italian: Ordini a uno dei membri del tuo gruppo d'abbordaggio di legarlo e sorvegliarlo. Tarquin ti copre di insulti e si dimena mentre lo perquisisci, trovando una pistola e un coltello nascosti, e il gettone di credito con cui stava per pagarti. Vai a liberare l'equipaggio della nave.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	The crew quarters have been fashioned into a brig with stout cell doors. There is no obvious way to open them, so you and your compatriots begin blasting them open.|629|0
units.english: The crew quarters have been fashioned into a brig with stout cell doors. There is no obvious way to open them, so you and your compatriots begin blasting them open.
units.italian: Gli alloggi dell'equipaggio sono stati trasformati in una cella con porte robuste. Non c'è un modo evidente di aprirle, così tu e i tuoi compagni cominciate a farle saltare.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	Suddenly, a warning klaxon cuts through the noise with a harsh staccato. The ship's self-destruct sequence has been activated! You race to the room where Tarquin was being held, and find that he has somehow escaped. In his place is an unconscious member of your crew with a savage slash across his face, evidently inflicted by an additional concealed weapon you didn't manage to find. A nearby panel indicates that an escape pod has been jettisoned.|630|0
units.english: Suddenly, a warning klaxon cuts through the noise with a harsh staccato. The ship's self-destruct sequence has been activated! You race to the room where Tarquin was being held, and find that he has somehow escaped. In his place is an unconscious member of your crew with a savage slash across his face, evidently inflicted by an additional concealed weapon you didn't manage to find. A nearby panel indicates that an escape pod has been jettisoned.
units.italian: All'improvviso un clacson d'allarme squarcia il rumore con uno staccato aspro. La sequenza di autodistruzione della nave è stata attivata! Corri nella stanza dove era tenuto Tarquin e scopri che è in qualche modo fuggito. Al suo posto c'è un membro del tuo equipaggio privo di sensi, con uno squarcio feroce sul volto, evidentemente inferto da un'altra arma nascosta che non sei riuscito a trovare. Un pannello vicino indica che una capsula di salvataggio è stata espulsa.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	The ship will explode in less than 30 seconds. You realize bitterly that there is no chance you can release the prisoners in time, and trying anyway will just get everyone killed. You and your boarding party storm angrily back to your ship and release the docking clamps just in time for the <origin> to disintegrate into a cloud of space debris, cruelly ending the already unhappy lives of captain Tarquin's victims.|631|0
units.english: The ship will explode in less than 30 seconds. You realize bitterly that there is no chance you can release the prisoners in time, and trying anyway will just get everyone killed. You and your boarding party storm angrily back to your ship and release the docking clamps just in time for the <origin> to disintegrate into a cloud of space debris, cruelly ending the already unhappy lives of captain Tarquin's victims.
units.italian: La nave esploderà in meno di 30 secondi. Capisci con amarezza che non hai alcuna possibilità di liberare i prigionieri in tempo, e che provarci comunque farebbe morire tutti. Tu e il tuo gruppo d'abbordaggio tornate furiosi sulla nave e sganciate i morsetti d'attracco appena in tempo perché la <origin> si disintegri in una nuvola di detriti spaziali, ponendo crudelmente fine alle vite già infelici delle vittime del capitano Tarquin.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	You vow that it will be the last time you underestimate captain Tarquin, should your paths cross again.|634|0
units.english: You vow that it will be the last time you underestimate captain Tarquin, should your paths cross again.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	You search Tarquin and find a concealed handgun and several knives, the credit chip he was going to pay you, and a tiny unlocking device. Then you instruct one of the members of your boarding party to lock him in your ship's brig. Tarquin curses you foully as he is marched to captivity at gunpoint. You resolve to figure out what to do with him later, and go to rescue the ship's crew.|638|0
units.english: You search Tarquin and find a concealed handgun and several knives, the credit chip he was going to pay you, and a tiny unlocking device. Then you instruct one of the members of your boarding party to lock him in your ship's brig. Tarquin curses you foully as he is marched to captivity at gunpoint. You resolve to figure out what to do with him later, and go to rescue the ship's crew.
units.italian: Perquisisci Tarquin e trovi una pistola e diversi coltelli nascosti, il gettone di credito con cui stava per pagarti e un piccolo dispositivo di sblocco. Poi ordini a uno dei membri del tuo gruppo d'abbordaggio di chiuderlo nella cella della tua nave. Tarquin ti copre di insulti mentre viene portato in prigionia sotto la minaccia delle armi. Decidi di pensare più tardi a cosa farne e vai a liberare l'equipaggio della nave.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	You gun captain Tarquin down in cold blood, to the shock of at least one member of your boarding party. units.english: You gun captain Tarquin down in cold blood, to the shock of at least one member of your boarding party. Good riddance to bad rubbish, you think, as you search the body of ex-captain Tarquin. You find a concealed handgun and several knives, the credit chip he was going to pay you, and a tiny unlocking device. You go to rescue his crew with it.
units.italian: Abbatti il capitano Tarquin a sangue freddo, con shock di almeno un membro del tuo gruppo d'abbordaggio. Che se ne sia andato al diavolo, pensi, mentre perquisisci il corpo dell'ex capitano Tarquin. Trovi una pistola e diversi coltelli nascosti, il gettone di credito con cui stava per pagarti e un piccolo dispositivo di sblocco. Vai a liberare il suo equipaggio con quello.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	Tarquin eyes your boarding party and stares at you icily for at least five uncomfortable seconds before finally replying. "Fine," he said coldly, his eyes blazing with barely contained rage, even as the rest of his face remains calm. He remains as tense as a steel cable as you and your team repair the ship in stony silence, awkwardly collecting your payment once the <origin> is up and running again.|650|0
units.english: Tarquin eyes your boarding party and stares at you icily for at least five uncomfortable seconds before finally replying. "Fine," he said coldly, his eyes blazing with barely contained rage, even as the rest of his face remains calm. He remains as tense as a steel cable as you and your team repair the ship in stony silence, awkwardly collecting your payment once the <origin> is up and running again.
units.italian: Tarquin osserva il tuo gruppo d'abbordaggio e ti fissa gelido per almeno cinque secondi imbarazzanti prima di rispondere. "Va bene", dice freddo, gli occhi che ardono di una rabbia a stento contenuta, mentre il resto del volto resta calmo. Resta teso come un cavo d'acciaio mentre tu e la tua squadra riparate la nave in un silenzio di pietra, ritirando goffamente il pagamento quando la <origin> torna a funzionare.

units.italian: Ti senti sollevato che tutta la faccenda sia finita quando sei al sicuro di nuovo a bordo della tua nave.

units.italian: "Ci vorrà un giorno freddo all'inferno prima che mi lasci ricattare da qualcuno abbastanza stupido da salire da solo su una nave in avaria", sogghigna Tarquin.

units.english: Captain Tarquin throws back his head and laughs at the exact moment that he draws a concealed pistol and shoots you with it five times - all in the blink of an eye. Your last thoughts concern the effectiveness of his distraction and the foolishness of your bravado.

units.id: mission:Slave Crew Rescue|	The ship's crew quarters have been fashioned into a brig with stout cell doors. Fortunately the unlocking device opens them all, and close to a dozen malnourished wretches stumble out, telling you the whole story: captain Tarquin has been keeping them as slaves for the past several months, locking them in their quarters when the ship makes berth, and with no food as a punishment when they complain. They are quite happy to see his lifeless body sprawled out on the deck plating.|677|0
units.english: The ship's crew quarters have been fashioned into a brig with stout cell doors. Fortunately the unlocking device opens them all, and close to a dozen malnourished wretches stumble out, telling you the whole story: captain Tarquin has been keeping them as slaves for the past several months, locking them in their quarters when the ship makes berth, and with no food as a punishment when they complain. They are quite happy to see his lifeless body sprawled out on the deck plating.
units.italian: Gli alloggi dell'equipaggio della nave sono stati trasformati in una cella con porte robuste. Per fortuna il dispositivo di sblocco le apre tutte, e quasi una dozzina di disgraziati denutriti esce barcollando, raccontandoti tutta la storia: il capitano Tarquin li teneva come schiavi da diversi mesi, chiudendoli nei loro alloggi quando la nave attraccava e senza cibo come punizione quando si lamentavano. Sono molto contenti di vedere il suo corpo senza vita disteso sul pavimento della nave.
